principle: Independent admission of the exact immutable F-MR19 candidate; owner conclusions are evidence input only.

checks_each_count: continuous-versus-restarted canonical result identity by column id
endpoint committed physical-state identity by column id
hard mass residual <= 1e-12 for all committed intervals
positive_matrix.identity_attack: Column IDs are deliberately non-consecutive in array order and result/state comparisons are performed by column ID rather than position.
positive_matrix.parameter_reference_attack: At least two logical columns share immutable parameter references; parameter payload identity is checked before/after and restart records are structurally checked to contain references only.
positive_matrix.scratch_attack: Restart record and bundle declarations are source-inspected for absence of worker/Newton/Jacobian/warm-start payloads.

negative_matrix: malformed decoded physical state of an incompatible concrete dynamic type

atomicity.requirement: A defect in the last record must leave every target state uninitialized; no partial registry publication is permitted.

mass.starting_storage_rule: Second-interval restarted mass accounting must be bitwise identical to continuous execution; restart must not inject or double-count storage.

early_exit_rule: Any hard negative, atomicity, source-lock or mass failure is sufficient for NOT_QUALIFIED; do not modify production source in F-MQ25.
